name: Hemlock
tagline: Four-person full-spectrum infrared sauna in sustainable Hemlock.
description: The OneBase Hemlock Quad is the light-filled sauna. Smooth-grained, hypoallergenic Hemlock gives a clean contemporary look that suits a modern spa or high-end residence, while the same low-EMF full-spectrum infrared system delivers restorative 135–149°F sessions for four people.

highlights.title: Premium Hemlock craftsmanship
highlights.body: Selected for durability and resistance to warping. A clean, contemporary aesthetic that keeps its integrity under frequent multi-user sessions.

highlights.title: Capacity-optimised layout
highlights.body: Designed for four, with internal volume maximised for group sessions in social wellness settings.

highlights.title: Full-spectrum emission
highlights.body: Six full-spectrum heaters and four mica heaters deliver near, mid and far infrared for muscle repair and systemic relaxation.

highlights.title: Commercial-grade resilience
highlights.body: Heavy-duty tempered glass and reinforced hardware for longevity and easy sanitation.

highlights.title: Simple control
highlights.body: Intuitive interface and an energy-efficient design for commercial facilities and private residences alike.

electrical.label: Supply
electrical.value: 220/240 V single-phase · min. 15 A breaker (>15 A recommended to avoid nuisance tripping)

electrical.label: 110/120 V regions
electrical.value: Ask an electrician about wiring to 208 V · min. 15 A (>18 A recommended)

faqs.a: Infrared panels heat your body directly rather than the surrounding air, giving a sauna experience at a more comfortable air temperature.

faqs.q: What makes the OneBase Hemlock different?
faqs.a: Commercial-grade build, durable Hemlock, smart controls and a plug-and-play design that handles high-traffic spa use yet suits a home.

faqs.q: Do infrared saunas require special installation?
faqs.a: No. The sauna is modular and easy to install for commercial upgrades or home wellness rooms.

seoTitle: OneBase Hemlock Quad — Commercial Infrared Sauna
seoDescription: Sustainable Hemlock four-person full-spectrum infrared sauna, 135–149°F, 3000 W. For health clubs, spas and residences.
